ratios.label: King Arthur Baking
ratios.quote: To convert from fresh yeast to instant or active dry yeast, multiply the fresh quantity by 0.33.

ratios.label: Red Star (Lesaffre)
ratios.quote: Its chart treats one 7g (¼oz) packet of dry yeast, or 2¼ teaspoons, as the match for about 0.6oz (17g) of fresh cake yeast.

yeast.interchangeable: Both makers treat active dry and instant (fast-action) yeast as interchangeable, weight for weight.
